<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

OSK built a fleet metro map POC (spine of milestones, workstream lines, stops per PR, live seat and verdict state). Jordan asked for it in pij as a utility any project can run from the /pij skill. This plan moves the page and generator into skills/pij/tools/fleet-map/, routes `pij fleet-map` through the node shim, reads seats, roles and verdicts from pij first (gh optional), fixes out-of-order merges, and keeps every POC requirement. One coder (pij-previous-firefly).

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- Any project's agents run `pij fleet-map generate` in its repo and get the map of that project in `<main checkout>/scratch/fleet-map/`, with no flags and no hardcoded project.
- The data comes from pij's own records (seats, directory, outputs) first; PR comments are a fallback.
- The skill's copy of the page and example can never be edited through a project's copy.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- Follow-up (named, not built): "who's awake" counting a seat waiting on a background job (`pij bg`) as awake.
- Follow-up (named, not built): seeding the structure from workstreams/roadmaps and the directory.
- Any Rust, daemon, hook, timer or poll. No auto-refresh.
- Rewriting the page: it stays the POC's code, made a template.
- Editing OSK files or retiring OSK's refresh.sh (OSK switches over after this lands).

## Acceptance criteria

| ac-0001 | One verb, project-relative defaults. `pij fleet-map init\|generate\|open` is routed by the node shim (harness/scripts/pij-cli.cjs) to skills/pij/tools/fleet-map/generate.mjs before pij-rs or tsx load. Run in a project's repo with no flags: the structure is `&lt;government-root&gt;/fleet-map/fleet-map.structure.json`, where government-root is the repo's one standing `prime-governance` worktree's `.harness/government` (the rules of harness/scripts/government-root.sh, done in the tool because other projects don't ship that script); the output is `&lt;main checkout&gt;/scratch/fleet-map/` (index.html and fleet-map.data.js). `init [--dir &lt;d&gt;]` writes the starter structure and refuses to overwrite one. `generate [--structure &lt;p&gt;] [--out &lt;d&gt;] [--at &lt;iso&gt;] [--offline] [--project &lt;slug&gt;]` writes the data and copies the page. `open [--out &lt;d&gt;] [--launch]` prints the file:// URL and opens it only with --launch. It warns on stderr when the output isn't git-ignored, and never runs git add or commit. No governance worktree or not a git repo: a refusal naming the missing piece and the flag that overrides it. | [ ] unchecked | — | — | [bp-0001](assets/backpressure.dd.md#rows) | — |
| ac-0002 | The skill copy can't be edited by accident. The page is copied, never symlinked. `--out`, `--dir` and `--structure` (and the defaults) are refused with a non-zero exit when their realpath, or for a path not yet created its nearest existing ancestor's realpath, is inside the tool folder's realpath; nothing is written. The colour write-back only writes the structure being generated from, which that refusal keeps outside the skill. The generated page and data start with: "generated by pij fleet-map from skills/pij/tools/fleet-map; edits here are overwritten; change the template in the pij repo". | [ ] unchecked | — | — | [bp-0002](assets/backpressure.dd.md#rows) | — |
| ac-0003 | Data from pij first. Seats and context from `pij list --json` (`.data.seats[]`: id, state, badge, sessionStatus.status.contextUsedTokens.value, contextUsed; checked against live output). Role holders and latest output from `pij directory --json [--project &lt;slug&gt;]` (`.data.roles[]`: id, title, live[].seat, latest_output). Verdicts per PR from one `pij outputs --subject pr:&lt;n&gt; --json` (every head): per role the newest verdict, preferring one at gh's head, shown as PASS, PASS WITH NOTES or BLOCK and flagged when at an older head. The POC's comment parser runs on gh's comments only for roles pij has no verdict for; where both exist pij wins. `gh pr view` supplies state, head, base, title, url and comments; gh missing or failing is a warning in the data, never an error, and pij verdicts still show. | [ ] unchecked | — | — | [bp-0003](assets/backpressure.dd.md#rows) | — |
| ac-0004 | The page keeps all 17 POC requirements, made a template: OSK's title and the empty-state hint become generic (`pij fleet-map generate`). Out-of-order merges: track is solid up to the first open stop as before; past it, each merged stop has solid track to the midpoints with its neighbours (to the spine if it is the last stop), so the gap is only at the open stops. Lines merged in order draw exactly as before. The train sits at the first open stop. | [ ] unchecked | — | — | [bp-0004](assets/backpressure.dd.md#rows) | — |

<a id="research-context"></a>

## Research Context

POC: OSK governance `fleet-map/` (index.html, generate.mjs, fleet-map.structure.json, README.md, refresh.sh, HANDOVER-pij.md with the 17 requirements). Live shapes checked 2026-11-17: `pij list --json` .data.seats (78 seats) with id/state/badge/contextUsed/sessionStatus; `pij directory --json` .data.roles[] with id/title/live[].seat/latest_output{at,head,kind,result,subject,writer}; `pij outputs --subject pr:N --json` .data.outputs[] with role/result/head/kind/at/writer, and `--head` matches only the full sha. OSK has a prime-governance worktree but no government-root.sh; pij-fleet ignores scratch/.

<a id="execution-guardrails"></a>

## Execution Guardrails

- Read-only on OSK files. No machine paths in committed files (local-paths check).
- Generated files only under a git-ignored or out-of-tree directory; never commit them.
- No `git add -A`, no `--no-verify`; node_modules never symlinked (C25).
- nice -n 19, one test run at a time. No cargo.
- Two review rounds, then ship (C34).
